description: VS Code-family editor (Cursor, VS Code, Insiders, VSCodium). Vars: config, ext, server.

options.label: HTTP, code and GPU caches
options.description: Chromium HTTP cache, V8 compiled JavaScript, GPU and WebGPU shader caches. Rebuilt automatically.

options.label: Compiled code cache of old versions (CachedData)
options.description: V8 bytecode caches per editor version; old version folders are never pruned. The newest one is kept.

options.label: Downloaded extension packages and caches
options.description: CachedExtensionVSIXs, CachedExtensions and CachedProfilesData. Re-downloaded when needed.

options.label: Webview service-worker caches
options.description: Service Worker CacheStorage and ScriptCache used by webviews.

options.label: Session logs and crash dumps
options.description: logs/ session folders and Crashpad reports.

options.label: Stale workspace storage
options.description: Per-workspace state and indexes for folders that no longer exist or were not opened for a long time (see Preferences). Opening such a folder again starts with fresh per-workspace extension state.

options.label: All workspace storage
options.description: Every workspace's state, indexes and extension data, including open projects. Resets per-workspace UI state, local history links and AI indexes.

options.label: Webview and session storage
options.description: blob_storage, Session Storage, Local Storage, IndexedDB and WebStorage. May sign you out of extensions and reset webview state.

options.label: Old local file history (Timeline)
options.description: Local History entries older than the configured age (Preferences).

options.label: Hot-exit backups of unsaved editors
options.description: Contents of editors that were never saved. Deleting them loses that text permanently.
options.extra_confirmation: I understand unsaved editor contents in Backups will be lost

options.label: Global extension/AI state (globalStorage) — report only
options.description: state.vscdb holds global extension and AI chat/agent history and can grow to tens of GB. It is never deleted by this app; clear history from inside the editor instead.

options.label: Backup copy of the global state DB (state.vscdb.backup)
options.description: Only the .backup copy is removed; the live state.vscdb is never touched.

options.label: Superseded extension versions
options.description: Older versions of installed extensions that were replaced by an update and are not referenced in extensions.json.

options.label: Old remote server builds
options.description: Server binaries for previous editor versions (bin/<commit>). The newest one is kept.

options.label: Remote server logs
options.description: Logs written by the remote server.

options.label: Superseded remote-server extension versions
options.description: Older extension versions installed by the remote server.
